hook: Sengupta has built enterprise AI functions from scratch at four different organizations, AXA XL, Zebra Technologies, and now JPMorgan Chase, while maintaining an active academic research career that produced over 9,100 citations and a co-authored analysis of the EU AI Act, a rare combination of frontier research credentials and boardroom-level AI deployment experience.
name: Biswa Sengupta

quote.text: I bridge two worlds that rarely overlap: frontier research credentials paired with boardroom-level technology strategy, P&L accountability, and the organisational change that makes transformation stick.
quote.context: Biswa Sengupta PhD, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief AI Technologist and Architect of JPMorgan's LLM Suite

quick_facts: Chief AI Technologist (Senior MD) at JPMorgan Chase, architect of LLM Suite, the firm's generative AI platform serving 300,000+ employees
Co-author of 'The EU AI Act and the Wager on Trustworthy AI' in Communications of the ACM
Holds a PhD in Computation and Dynamical Systems from the University of Cambridge, with over 9,100 academic citations
Co-founded Stanhope AI, an autonomous drone navigation company serving Royal Navy and US Navy programs

achievements.title: Architect and enterprise lead, JPMorgan LLM Suite (2024-present)
achievements.impact: Built the firm's flagship generative AI platform serving over 300,000 employees, unlocking multi-billion-dollar annual ROI and cutting AI deployment cycles from quarters to weeks while maintaining regulatory compliance.

achievements.title: Managing Director, AI Products and Cloud Platform, JPMorgan CIB (2022-2024)
achievements.impact: Built and scaled a global AI/ML organization embedding AI across custody, settlement, risk management, and client advisory functions.

achievements.title: Co-authoring 'The EU AI Act and the Wager on Trustworthy AI', Communications of the ACM
achievements.impact: Contributed policy analysis on AI governance to one of computing's most widely read professional publications.

achievements.title: Building AXA XL's global AI Centre of Excellence across 6 countries
achievements.impact: Delivered hundreds of millions of dollars in business impact, embedding AI-driven document extraction, risk classification, and recommender systems into core underwriting workflows.

achievements.title: Technical Fellow (L10) and Global Head of Machine Learning, Zebra Technologies
achievements.impact: Served on the CTO's leadership team, delivering production AI across retail, warehouse, and healthcare and leading technical due diligence for multi-billion-dollar acquisitions.
